<?php
class Base186Owner { public const VALUE = 1; }
class Owner186Owner extends Base186Owner { public const VALUE = 2; public function capture() { return function() { yield 'PAUSE'; yield new class(parent::VALUE, self::VALUE, static::VALUE, __CLASS__, __FUNCTION__, __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public int $parent, public int $self, public int $called, public string $owner, public string $function, public string $method) {} }; }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'DROP;'; } }
class Child186Owner extends Owner186Owner { public const VALUE = 3; }
$owner = new Child186Owner; $factory = $owner->capture(); $g = $factory(); unset($owner, $factory); echo 'CREATED;', $g->current(), ';'; $g->next(); $child = $g->current(); echo $child->parent, ';', $child->self, ';', $child->called, ';', $child->owner, ';', $child->function, ';', $child->method, ';', $child::class, ';'; $g->next(); echo 'CLOSED;'; unset($g); echo 'AFTER;';

<?php
trait T186Arrow { public function capture() { return fn() => yield new class(self::VALUE, static::VALUE, __CLASS__, __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public int $self, public int $called, public string $owner, public string $method) {} }; } }
class A186Arrow { use T186Arrow; public const VALUE = 1; } class B186Arrow { use T186Arrow; public const VALUE = 2; } class C186Arrow extends A186Arrow { public const VALUE = 3; }
$a = new C186Arrow; $b = new B186Arrow; $fa = $a->capture(); $fb = $b->capture(); $ga = $fa(); $gb = $fb(); unset($a, $b, $fa, $fb); $y = $gb->current(); $x = $ga->current(); $after = new class {}; echo $x->self, ':', $x->called, ':', $x->owner, ':', $x->method, ';', $y->self, ':', $y->called, ':', $y->owner, ':', $y->method, ';', ($x::class === $y::class), ';', $x::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
$owner = new class { public function capture() { return static function() { yield new class(__CLASS__, __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public string $owner, public string $method) {} }; }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER-DROP;'; } };
$factory = $owner->capture(); $g = $factory(); unset($owner, $factory); $child = $g->current(); $after = new class {}; echo $child->owner, ';', $child->method, ';', $child::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
$owner = new class { public function capture() { return function(): int { yield new class { final private function hidden() {} }; }; } };
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
trait T186Default { public function capture() { return static fn() => yield new class { public function bad(int $value = 'wrong') {} }; } }
echo 'BAD;';
